title: Descartes as Jesuit agent sent to infiltrate the Rosicrucians
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Descartes as Jesuit agent sent to infiltrate the Rosicrucians, about 17th century at France, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: they were Jesuits. And they had sent Renee Decart to infiltrate the Rosacruian order

plain: A philosopher named Jason Jorjani, on Jesse Michels' podcast, says that the Jesuits, a Catholic religious order, sent René Descartes, the 17th-century French philosopher, to infiltrate the Rosicrucians, a secretive mystical brotherhood of the time. Jorjani lays this out in his book Prometheus and Atlas. If true, it would mean one of the founders of modern thought began as a kind of religious spy.
